messages:
sam: :rotating_light: Seeing huge DB latency from prod -- p50 200ms -> 800ms, p99 ~6s, and a few 502s from the gateway. Anyone available for a quick war-room?

maria: on it, give me a minute to finish a deploy, but I can join. set bridge?

sam: created a zoom bridge — https://zoom.us/j/987654321?pwd=ZmFrZXBhc3N3b3Jk — join now if you can. Agenda: 1) quick triage 2) rollback if needed 3) mitigation (rate limit/circuit)

jordan: joining now. I've seen a flurry of `SELECT` spikes targeting the user_meta table around the timestamps. Pulling slow query log.

lia: alerts show DB connection errors ~1719854200 -> 1719854400, and a small blip of node OOM on app-4 at 1719854255. I'm switching alert channels to the bridge.

alex: I can halt the latest deploy (sha `b7c9f2a`) if that's likely. What changed in that release?

sam: b7c9f2a added a new background job that batches profile lookups. Could be spiking DB. Jordan, can you grep slow queries and paste sample?

jordan: pasting top slow query snippet:

```
# slow query (avg 2.3s, 12 occurrences)
SELECT u.id, u.email, m.last_seen
FROM users u
JOIN user_meta m ON m.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.id IN (<hundreds of ids>)
ORDER BY m.last_seen DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

jordan: looks like a new batch pattern hitting `IN (<lots>)`. N+1-ish but in bulk. Pool exhaustion possible.

maria: that background job was the batch-enricher, runs on save. It should chunk by 50, but I see a change that bumped it to 500 in the config. reverting that is quick.

sam: ok roles: sam - facilitator, jordan - DB triage, maria - code rollback / config revert, lia - infra (alerts/restarts), alex - deploy hold/rollback.

maria: pushing a hotfix to revert chunk size to 50 now. Command I'll run: `kubectl set env deploy/enricher CHUNK_SIZE=50 -n prod`

alex: holding the rollout of b7c9f2a and disabling automatic retries on the job queue.

deploy-bot: Deployment hold applied for `service/enricher` at 1719854350 by alex.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by jordan at 1719854362. Priority: high. Pager duty note: war-room active.

lia: restarting one DB replica to clear stale connections (read-replica-2). Doing a graceful restart now.

jordan: after the restart and the CHUNK_SIZE revert, I'm seeing query times drop in sampling. p99 down to 1.2s in the last 2 minutes.

maria: hotfix env set and job config reverted. I also disabled the enricher cron for the next 30m.

alex: rolling back the service is still an option but looks like config revert did the trick. holding rollback for 10m to confirm.

sam: confirm we have mitigations: config revert, restart replica, hold deploy. Anything else?

jordan: adding a quick index candidate: `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON user_meta (user_id, last_seen);` but we should schedule in a maintenance window. Not doing it mid-incident.

lia: alerts cleared for latency in the last 5m. No new OOMs.

maria: can we add a temporary rate limit for the enricher API to protect DB if it retries? I'll open a PR, but can also set a kube Ingress rate-limit for 10 rps.

sam: good call — lia, can you stand up an ingress rate-limit rule until we confirm stability?

lia: done — ingress rate limit set to 10rps for /enricher at 1719854480.

jordan: p99 stabilized ~700ms now, p50 ~120ms. Looks healthy.

alex: removing the deployment hold at 1719854560, but not rolling forward until we ship an additional safe-guard.

sam: thanks everyone. Action items: 1) maria to open PR to permanently fix chunking + add canary (maria) 2) jordan to propose index + run capacity plan (jordan) 3) lia to keep temporary rate-limit and monitor (lia) 4) alex to document rollback and gating (alex). We'll run a short postmortem tomorrow.

maria: will do, PR coming in ~30min.

jordan: I'll draft the index proposal and capacity numbers by EOD.

lia: monitoring dashboard updated and 1h retention for traces set.

sam: closing war-room in bridge. Thanks :thumbsup: Great quick work. I'll start a postmortem doc and tag you all.

maria: thanks, good triage.

alex: nice work team.

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved at 1719854598.

sam: marking incident resolved, follow-up postmortem link: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/2024-06-xyz-db-latency (draft).
